body:
I read that this herb helped with dreaming abilities and decided to go ahead. I found one report of a guy who took 5g of the root and steeped it in water and had a solid report over a period of a few uses.
I ordered Calamus Root Essential Oil and this was my first mistake. I know how potent the oils are compared to their plant counterparts but for some reason, went blind on the dosage and I didn't check other reports. I am such an idiot; I usually never make these mistakes with dosage.
Hindsight 20/20 it says that Calamus root is not good for internal consumption due to its ability to induce vomiting.
I retrieved an empty pill casing and put 5 drops of the oil in and then proceeded to put 2 drops on each arm for a total of 9 drops. (WTF WAS I THINKING)
I even put 8 drops into my diffuser near my bed, this is what I should have done and skip ingesting. Puke party from hell for 12 hours.
3/24/2017
1:41am - Took the Dosage.
2:00am - went to Sleep.
5:00am - INTENSE NAUSEA AWAKENS ME.
5:10am - The Puke Party Begins (Every 5-10 mins a wave of dry heaves and bile expelling with HEAVY cold sweats and uncontrollable shaking at times).
8:00am - Had to call off of work, there was no way I was going anywhere.
12:30pm - The nausea subsides and  I can finally get some rest without vomiting.
1:30pm -  I decide to get out  of bed to get some hydration and cell salts. My urine was brown, and my body was shaken to its core.  My abs hurt and I was tired from only 2-4 hours of sleep.
1:45pm - I call up my work and tell them I'm feeling better and go in.
2:00pm - At work I try to eat some food but its slow eating, the nausea still creeps up, I think its more mental than anything at this point.
3:00pm - I'm feeling really tired now and cannot wait to get home, kind of regretting going into work but it was a good choice to do so. Got some things done.
3:05pm
** FINAL THOUGHTS **
THIS SHIT IS POWERFUL
DO NOT INGEST THE ESSENTIAL OIL - PLEASE I BEG YOU
It is only good for use on the skin or in a diffuser.
I did not experience any type of 'Trip' or Dream enhancement, this was most likely due to my vomit party. I am sure this herb has powers to be unlocked and I will tread a lot more carefully with it. This was a wake up call for me.
**I  made a massive medical blunder, a learning experience for sure**
I never puked like that in my entire 28 years spent in this body, although I did get my stomach pumped at the age of 5, this probably was a similar experience. I was in my shower thinking I was dying. I didn't think my body had that much bile to give.
Blessings to all, be safe with herbs or else you can get your ass kicked.
